quarterly_data.quarter: Teradyne press release: Teradyne Introduces UltraFLEXplus S Series for Edge AI (10-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Teradyne announced the launch of the UltraFLEXplus S series, a single-module extension of its UltraFLEXplus platform for high-mix, variable-volume semiconductor manufacturing for edge AI applications, positioned alongside the quad-module UltraFLEXplus Q series. The first model, UltraFLEXplus S24, is a 24-slot system for engineering and production use, aimed at integrated device manufacturers (IDMs) and OSATs; it uses the same instrument module ecosystem, IG-XL software environment and test program library as the Q series and supports engineering and production test insertions, including tri-temperature testing, for microcontrollers (MCUs), multimedia and edge AI devices across automotive, industrial and consumer end markets.
